name: Cola2 (continuous-latent language model)

lineage.how_derived: trained from scratch on 346.03B source tokens: Stage I jointly trains a dynamic-compression VAE encoder and a token decoder, Stage II continues adapting the VAE with token-side supervision while a latent prior (block-causal Diffusion Transformer) is trained

purpose: A research base model for hierarchical language modeling: text is grouped into semantic spans, each compressed into a continuous latent, latent blocks are generated by a DiT and realized as discrete tokens by a span-causal decoder.

license.name: none declared on the HF card
license.notes: No license tag and no LICENSE file in the HF repo (404 on raw/main/LICENSE, 2026-11-19); the GitHub repo was not opened.

architecture.kind: continuous-latent hierarchical language model (dynamic-compression VAE + block-causal DiT + span-causal decoder)
architecture.why_this_design: Card and paper title: co-adaptation of semantic compression and discrete text generation ('Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation'); latent generation is stochastic. The card gives no parameter count.

variants.notes: includes evaluation JSONL and SHA256SUMS; training code not released

pc-12gb.notes: 35 GB of weights, parameter count not stated

other: Transformers remote code; reference inference in the ByteDance-Seed/Cola2 GitHub repository

benchmarks.name: Average over eight evaluation tasks
benchmarks.variant: paper results, stochastic latent generation, individual runs may differ

weaknesses: Base model only, no instruction tuning, no license declared on the card
avoid_for: any practical assistant or coding use
